mechanism_narrative: A lower FEDFUNDS level (in percent) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20d returns is not significantly negative (Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 305, restrictive monetary policy combined with high inflation compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 305 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong labor market conditions support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when UNRATE < 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0, strong economic activity compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 102.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS exceeds 156000 and UNRATE is below 3.8%, tight labor market conditions support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when PAYEMS > 156000 AND UNRATE < 3.8 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 305, monetary tightening combined with high inflation compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 305 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1350.0, strong housing market conditions support economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns when HOUST > 1350.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.
